A psalm to pray this Wednesday (November 18, New Calendar): Psalm 4, read in full.

“When I called upon him, the God of my righteousness heard me: you have made room for me in tribulation; pity me, and listen to my prayer.”

“Many say, Who will show us good things? the light of your countenance, O Lord, has been manifested towards us.” And the psalm closes: “I will both lie down in peace and sleep: for you, Lord, only have caused me to dwell securely.”
